1001.attr_4_desc: When hits an enemy whose max HP is greater, increase Armor Ingored by10+0.2* your Physical Def, increase Spell Penetra by 10+0.2* your Spell Resist
1001.name: Skylight

1002.attr_4_desc: Every 8 damages received, the next damage received will be returned to the damage dealler. CD: 3 seconds.
1002.name: RailFire Eyes

1003.attr_4_desc: When making a critical strike, add additional damage of your 5% of your current HP + 1% of the enemy's max HP, the upper limit is 100,000, CD: 6 seconds.
1003.name: Chronological

1004.attr_4_desc: Every time 30% of the max HP damage is received, the enemy within a certain range will be stunned.
1004.name: Nucleus

1005.attr_4_desc: The duration of negative state released by your own will be extended by 20%, and the armor and magic resistance of the enemy in a specific negative state will be reduced by 50 points.
1005.name: Wild Rope

1006.attr_4_desc: When the HP is lower than 20%, it will enter the invincible state for 3 seconds, and restore 3% of max HP per second within 10 seconds (can only be triggered once).
1006.name: Peace Song

1007.attr_4_desc: When attacking, it will add 12% damage to the target's lost HP, the upper limit is 50000, CD: 10 seconds.
1007.name: Reincarnation

1008.attr_4_desc: At the beginning of the battle, restore 100 energy for all allies (the only passive in the team), and restore 100 energy for itself.
1008.name: Tracing

1009.attr_4_desc: When making a critical strike, sputter 30% of the damage to the enemy with the lowest max HP , CD: 5 seconds.
1009.name: Curse

1010.attr_4_desc: Generates a 3-second shield while resisting the negative state. CD: 12 seconds. Negative state duration is reduced by 20%.
1010.name: Astral

1011.attr_4_desc: No set bonus. The Oath Soul Stone itself provides a large amount of Horcrux experience, which can be used as experience props when strengthening other Horcruxes.
1011.name: Oath
